lxc_104edd7c5b83c3ad.text: A soft drink is a cold drink with bubbles.

lxc_3849300d33b98669.text: The bubbles come from a gas called carbon dioxide.

lxc_8535caafd15eeb31.text: This gas makes the drink fizzy.

lxc_4e4cd27975c709ce.text: Most soft drinks also have sugar and water.

lxc_86cf44609010e335.text: Coca-Cola, for example, has water, sugar, and a special mix of flavors.

lxc_5152811f62625bd3.text: It was made in Atlanta, USA, in 1886.

lxc_20113d1dd39f8e9c.text: Today, people drink about 1.9 billion servings of Coca-Cola every day.

lxc_dc467c872afd7ca0.text: Two of the biggest soft drink brands are Coca-Cola and Pepsi.

lxc_0e080aa71b25e523.text: Pepsi also started in the USA, in 1893.

lxc_c80008628ad43bf0.text: Both drinks are cola — dark, sweet, and fizzy.

lxc_4c185b175ddb698f.text: Today, you can buy Coca-Cola in more than 200 countries.

lxc_17198d265b22a08d.text: Pepsi is sold in more than 200 countries too.

lxc_095f838a3667d70c.text: These brands spend billions of dollars on advertising every year.

lxc_0925cc66d8ef098c.text: Most soft drinks have a lot of sugar.

lxc_5eca1d20462a5d63.text: One can of regular Coca-Cola has about 39 grams of sugar.

lxc_40876b46bc4d421e.text: Doctors say too much sugar is not good for your health.

lxc_cad42b4780485787.text: Because of this, many companies now make drinks with less sugar.

lxc_5109b5cc7a901289.text: Diet Coke, for example, has no sugar.

lxc_c7e9d1cd9695d1e6.text: In 2023, sales of low-sugar drinks grew faster than regular soft drinks in many countries.

lxc_06366e0c378b38f2.text: Soft drink companies always try new flavors.

lxc_071d97fd73e3f20f.text: In 2023, Coca-Cola released a special flavor called Coca-Cola Starlight.

lxc_cc723bdecdd1308f.text: It was only available for a short time.

lxc_e7ef6e385c1da341.text: Pepsi also makes many different flavors, like Pepsi Mango and Pepsi Lime.

lxc_69d1e4bf9b0980aa.text: In Japan, Fanta makes unusual flavors like melon and grape.

lxc_8cdc84056a8b6436.text: New flavors help companies attract young people and stay popular.

lxc_71e7abeb69725b99.text: Soft drinks come in cans and plastic bottles.

lxc_2a0fe372ac818479.text: These can create a lot of waste.

lxc_b1d148cc4c444184.text: Many countries now ask people to recycle cans and bottles.

lxc_df3c7e67a411a38a.text: Coca-Cola said in 2022 that it wants all its packaging to be recyclable by 2025.

lxc_4a105ff79458ed70.text: Plastic bottles are a big problem for the ocean.

lxc_f771550637c22ca2.text: Some companies now use recycled plastic to make new bottles.

lxc_689c404a8ce1b7cd.text: Soft drinks are everywhere — in stores, restaurants, and homes around the world.

lxc_5cd5b9cdad03b89a.text: From fizzy cola to fruit juice, billions of people drink them every day.

lxc_53e7488c026fcfb1.text: We look at what makes soft drinks special, where they come from, and why so many people love them.

lxc_be2e7b15da6d3e59.text: Soft drinks are popular around the world.

lxc_6d545cf6b0c7c449.text: They are fizzy because of carbon dioxide.

lxc_ee69dd936bb11e33.text: Big brands like Coca-Cola and Pepsi sell their drinks in more than 200 countries.

lxc_01ca0a2777bb26db.text: Many people are now choosing drinks with less sugar.

lxc_f7783bb42ca5bb4c.text: Companies also try new flavors and think about the environment.
